name: rico_bloom

patterns.description: Brief bloom telegraph, then fan of bouncing orbs that ricochet off soft arena bounds.
Slow spin while spitting single orbs at intervals — punish standing still.

intro_notes: Clear or freeze trash for a beat → WARNING banner → camera punch → fight. Gold chest on kill.
notes: Boss 1 (~5:00). Readable bouncing-orb exam. Weak to kiting; do not make it an HP sponge. Sprite placeholder: res://assets/sprites/enemies/rico_bloom.png
